title.narrative: Leadership for Education for Sustainable Development- LEAD-ESD

description.narrative: The project, “Leadership for Education for Sustainable Development- LEAD-ESD” is informed by several developments. Globally, there has been a rallying of global efforts towards attaining the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030 with a growing recognition of the central role of education in achieving all the 17 SDGs. Within this context, in the Transforming Education Summit (TES) held in 2022, six Calls to Action were issued, among which is the Greening Education Partnership (GEP) - Getting Every Learner Climate Ready. Greening Education Partnership is structured around four key pillars of transformative education- Greening schools, Greening curriculum, Greening teacher training and education systems’ capacities, and Greening communities. These interventions are rooted in UNESCO’s longstanding work in Education for Sustainable Development (ESD), with a particular focus on education's role in tackling climate change, UNESCO aims to equip individuals and communities, with the skills, values, and attitudes for shaping green, low-emission, and climate-resilient societies. In this biennium (2024-2025), Member States in Eastern Africa have requested that the capacities of their teacher educators and key stakeholders of the education sector be strengthened to integrate ESD into their curricula and to equip teachers to facilitate this learning in schools.
